shots.content_purpose: Establish the woman in the night parking lot, show the Coca-Cola can presented and set down, reveal the glowing “互惠” sign as she points at the store, sustain her earlier speech, and end as she bends down and the plastic bag starts to rise into frame.
shots.description: A locked medium shot holds <Subject 1> (S1) center frame in the parking lot of <Subject 2>. She raises <Subject 4> in her right hand toward the camera, turning the can so its red body and white Coca-Cola script face the lens in the storefront light, holds it for a beat, then lowers it and sets it down on the metal table at the left edge of frame, where it stays standing. Without moving the camera, she turns her upper body and points back at the store behind her, and the camera tilts up with small amplitude at slow speed so the glowing white sign under the green awning is clearly readable above her shoulder: the sign, which in <Video 1> read "全家", now reads "互惠" with the same white glow, two-character size, spacing and position. She turns back to face the lens and speaks (S1), her earlier line carried over unchanged from <Audio 1> with her lips moving in sync to that reused audio. She then bends down out of the lower frame, and the top of <Subject 3>, the white translucent plastic bag, rises into the lower frame between both her hands.

shots.content_purpose: Show the bag's contents as individual Coca-Cola cans in a tight ending framing and deliver the replaced closing line on the bag close-up.
shots.cut_reason: The main observation target changes from the woman's actions in the wide parking-lot framing to the individual identities of the cans inside the bag, which that framing cannot resolve.
shots.continuity_bridge: Shot 1 ends as she bends down out of the lower frame and the bag's top rises into the bottom of frame; Shot 2 begins as the same bag comes up in both her hands, the bag never leaving her grip across the cut.
shots.description: At 00:11.000, the shot cuts to a closer framing as <Subject 3> comes up in both her hands in front of her chest. She opens the bag's mouth toward the lens, and the camera pushes in with large amplitude at slow speed until the bag's opening fills the frame; inside, the original red chip bag, yellow packet, red-and-white box and green-capped bottle are all gone, replaced by several <Subject 4> cans packed together with their white script and wave readable through the plastic. The plastic crinkles and the cans clink lightly as she tilts the bag open, her face just above the bag's edge. As the push-in settles she speaks her closing line (S1) in the same voice carried over from <Audio 1>, <d>[Chinese] 买了一堆可乐</d>, with her lips in sync, and the video ends on the close-up of the bag filled with Coca-Cola cans.
